title: evidence/stack.md
body:
# Technology Stack

_Mirrors `doc:architecture` §Stack and Technologies (citations live there). A convenience reference, read on demand._

## Languages & Runtimes
- Rust Cargo workspace, resolver "2", edition 2024, `rust-version` 1.91.0 (CI guarantees latest stable; an MSRV job builds only). `debug_timer` and `wgpu_texture` are edition 2021.
- Workspace version `0.3.0-beta.4`, license MIT OR Apache-2.0; in-repo engine crates pinned `=0.3.0-beta.4`, dioxus-native / dioxus-native-dom `0.7.0`.
- Nix flake dev shell: rust-bin stable 1.91.0, in sync with `rust-version`, with rust-src, rust-analyzer, clippy; openssl, fontconfig (Linux), pkg-config, python3 (build-time codegen for stylo). 
- Measured dev host (2026-10-05, Omarchy 4.0.4 / Arch): no flake; host stable rustc/cargo 1.99.0, no `rust-toolchain*` file; Arch fontconfig 2.18.3, openssl 3.6.4, pkgconf 3.0.7, python 3.14.7 stand in for CI's `libfontconfig1-dev` + python3.
- WASM: wasm-bindgen 0.2, web-sys, tracing-wasm, console_error_panic_hook; examples built with Trunk.

## Core Frameworks
| Layer | Technology |
|---|---|
| CSS engine | Servo Stylo 0.24 (stylo, stylo_traits, stylo_atoms, stylo_static_prefs, stylo_dom); selectors 0.43.0; cssparser 0.38.0 |
| HTML / XML parsing | html5ever 0.40.1, markup5ever 0.40.0, xml5ever 0.40.0 |
| Layout | Taffy 0.15 (upstream's git source, pinned to one revision — the one crate allowed a git source; std, flexbox, flexbox_balance, grid, block_layout, content_size, calc, detailed_layout_info) via `stylo_taffy` |
| Text & fonts | Parley 0.13 (registry), skrifa 0.49, fontique; ICU4X 2.3 (icu_casemap, icu_locale_core, icu_properties, icu_segmenter) with writeable 0.6 — icu_casemap and writeable behind blitz-dom's default `text-transform-icu`; `wuff` for WOFF/WOFF2 |
| Rendering | anyrender 0.15.0 + anyrender_vello / _vello_cpu / _vello_gpu / _skia / _svg / _serialize; wgpu 30 |
| Graphics | color 0.3, peniko 0.6.0, kurbo 0.13.1, usvg 0.50.0, svgtypes 0.16.2, euclid 0.22, app_units 0.7.5 |
| Windowing & input | winit `=0.31.0-beta.4`, raw-window-handle 0.6, clipboard text through winit, rfd 0.17.1, keyboard-types 0.8 (lock 0.8.3; Dioxus 0.7.3 carries its own 0.7, so two versions stand in the graph), cursor-icon 1 |
| Accessibility | accesskit 0.25; accesskit_xplat (windows 0.35, macos 0.27, unix 0.24, android 0.9) |
| Networking & async | url 2.5, http 1.1, data-url 0.3.1, tokio 1.42, reqwest 0.13 (rustls; native-tls vendored on Android), reqwest-middleware 0.5.1, http-cache =1.0.0-alpha.6 |
| JavaScript | Boa 0.22 (boa_engine with annex-b, boa_runtime, boa_gc) |
| UI framework | Dioxus 0.7.3 crates |
| Media | image 0.25.6, png 0.18 (since 2026-10-12-headless-screenshot also escher-driver's encoder of a shot and a blitz-tests dev-dependency, resolved 0.18.1, no package entering `Cargo.lock`; no `base64` crate taken), html-escape, percent-encoding, serde 1, serde_json 1 (1.0.151; since 2026-10-10-mcp-surface escher-driver's reader of MCP requests, of kept checks and of the live answer line a replay compares, writing nothing) |
| Parallelism & misc | rayon 1, slotmap, rustc-hash, bytes, smallvec, thin-vec, atomic_refcell, bitflags, bytemuck, pollster, smol_str, thread_local; mimalloc, the global allocator of two upstream-only binaries, the browser app (by default) and the WPT runner; no PRNG crate (since 2026-11-14-seeded-randomness): seeded randomness's splitmix64 is written by hand and its host fallback seed comes from std `RandomState`, no package entering `Cargo.lock` |

## Data Storage
- None in the engine. The browser app persists history with rusqlite 0.32 (bundled) + rusqlite_migration 1.3 (`history.sqlite3`); blitz-net's optional HTTP cache uses `CACacheManager` in the platform cache dir.

## Messaging & Events
- No broker. In-process: per-document mpsc channel drained at `resolve`; shell events over an mpsc channel + winit proxy.

## Observability
- `tracing` 0.1 + `tracing-subscriber` 0.3 behind per-crate `tracing` features in the engine; `tracing-log` 0.2 + `tracing-subscriber` (env-filter · fmt · registry · std · tracing-log) in escher-telemetry, escher's ungated stderr bootstrap; `tracing`, ungated, in escher-driver, which installs no global subscriber and sets only escher-telemetry's scoped capture default around an acting step (that capture installing once per process a chaining panic hook that keeps a panic's payload and location on the open capture, prints and logs nothing, and always runs the hook it replaced), for its `command` span and, since 2026-10-10-mcp-surface, its `tool_call` span; `log` + `env_logger` in the WPT runner; `debug_timer` phase timing behind `log-phase-times`. No OTel, metrics or error-reporting service.

## Development & CI
- `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --locked -- -D warnings` — then, only when that line is green and since 2026-10-14-quality-gates, upstream's own blitz-dom line `cargo clippy -p blitz-dom --no-default-features --features svg,woff,accessibility,system-fonts,file-input,custom-widget --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` — run as legs of `.github/scripts/ci-leg.sh` (the same script on the dev host; `ci-leg.sh fast` is the local pre-push gate, stopping at the first red and, on the dev host after a green verdict and skipped under CI, ending with the target sweep, whose refusal or failure never reddens it); `RUSTDOCFLAGS=-D warnings` is set workflow-wide and the docs job's `cargo doc --workspace --no-deps --locked` holds every workspace library crate to it; a cargo-deny audit of the advisories and licences of the whole workspace's graph (`deny.toml`) and a cargo-llvm-cov coverage report gated since 2026-10-14-quality-gates by per-crate line floors through `.github/scripts/coverage_floor.py` (escher-driver 97 %, dioxus-native-dom 83 %, blitz-test-harness 90 %) run as the `audit` and `coverage` legs, and the `stand-repeat` leg (not a fast leg) holds the stand checks to a zero-failure budget over three rounds; since 2026-10-16-fast-failing-mutants a mutation tier runs on the dev host alone, never in CI: cargo-mutants 27.1.0 with `--test-tool nextest` and `--baseline=skip`, its test tool cargo-nextest 0.9.146 under the `mutants` profile of the root `.config/nextest.toml` (fail-fast at the first failure, one priority override naming the direct tests; the default profile untouched), selected by `NEXTEST_PROFILE=mutants`, each unit's mutant test command read green on the unmutated tree first, the rdme and blitz packages (upstream's demo shells, holding no tests) not run by it and owed no test for it — neither tool lockfile-resolved (the recipe in test-plan §10); beside it, since 2026-10-26-codebase-health, a cognitive-complexity reading on the dev host alone, never in CI: `rust-code-analysis-cli` 0.0.25 in `~/.cargo/bin`, resolved by no lockfile and run by no CI leg, reading each function against the ceiling of 15.
- Dev profile `debug = "line-tables-only"` (one debuginfo level for host and CI; the test profile inherits it).
- GitHub Actions: `ci.yml` on PRs and pushes to `main`, `v0.*`, `build/**`, under a workflow-level `permissions: contents: read` with every `uses:` pinned to a 40-hex commit SHA, its ref kept as a trailing comment, as in every workflow — fast legs fmt, clippy, test, CI-script tests (no `needs`), then MSRV build, build, counter, wasm, docs (the whole workspace), dependency audit, accessibility (a11y) tests, coverage report, stand checks repeated (`stand-repeat`, since 2026-10-14-quality-gates, with a `jlumbroso/free-disk-space` free-disk step) and the windows/macos/ios/android matrix; rust-cache on every compiling job but coverage (saved on `main` + `build/*`; a11y and, since 2026-10-14-quality-gates, stand-repeat restore the test job's `workspace-test` key and never save), a 7-day `ci-log-*` artifact per failed leg and a 7-day `coverage-report` artifact on success. `wpt.yml` (css + svg WPT, scores, Pages), `wpt-post-results.yml`, `publish-browser.yml` (dx bundle, signed builds) run only in `DioxusLabs/blitz` (repository guard).
- CI scripts: Python 3 — 3.11 or later, since `test_blitz_tests_targets.py` reads a manifest with the stdlib `tomllib` (`wpt_diff_to_pr.py`, upstream's `wpt_area_changes.py`, since 2026-10-14-quality-gates escher's `coverage_floor.py` — the coverage leg's floor — and its tests `test_coverage_floor.py`, stdlib only, unittest suites; `test_ci_workflows.py` needs PyYAML, which the `ci-scripts` job installs only where `import yaml` fails), the bash leg runner `ci-leg.sh` and the bash install script `apt-install.sh` — fork CI's one statement of its package install, using the runner image's `sudo`, GNU `timeout`, `apt-get` and, since 2026-10-14-quality-gates, `dpkg` (`dpkg --configure -a`, its bounded repair before a retried attempt), no package or action added.
- Cold-agent run pipe (operator host only, ratified by the founder, 2026-10-06): the Claude Code CLI `claude` as the agent client (read at 2.1.308 on the dev host, the live run's `client_version` the same (at 2026-10-25-cold-agent-bar); a `run` precondition, not a CI requirement — CI runs only the pipe's shim tests), its MCP server since 2026-10-15-cold-agent-test the workspace's own `escher-session mcp` (a `run` precondition built by the operator, never by the pipe; the stub retired with that chunk), and its judge stdlib python3 (`datetime json os queue re subprocess sys threading`), no package added.
- Testing deps: blitz-test-harness, seven_guis (the headless stand), escher-driver (the driver session), test-that 0.6.0, usvg and, since 2026-10-12-headless-screenshot, png, which `stand_act_screenshot` and `stand_screenshot_repeat` decode a shot with, and since 2026-10-13-upstream-sync-polish-and-ship cursor-icon, for upstream's `pointer_leave` check's hand-written `ShellProvider`; seven_guis' unix-gated test target `cli_flow` runs two POSIX `sh` scripts under plain `sh` and its `recording` target a third, `record_checks.sh`, under `sh` to record the two committed checks and compare them byte for byte — a shell is those two targets' requirement, no dependency or framework added; WPT runner: dify 0.7.4, wptreport 0.0.5, glob, regex, owo-colors.

## Infrastructure
- Library workspace — no deployment target for the engine. The browser bundles per platform via `dx bundle --package browser --release --profile production --locked` (upstream `DioxusLabs/blitz` only); Nix `packages.browser`; WASM examples via Trunk.

## Third-party services
- None at runtime. Upstream CI uses GitHub Pages and a repository dispatch to `DioxusLabs/blitz-wpt-results`; neither runs on the fork. The fork's Actions cache (10 GB per-repository budget, least-recently-used eviction) held 12 entries, 10 723 071 252 B — over the budget — after the first run on a re-keyed lockfile (CI run 37386253475, 2026-10-05).

## Rationale
See `doc:architecture` §Established Decisions — each `[Tag]` explains a pin or a default.

## Version updates
1. Amend `doc:architecture` §Stack (via the pipeline's amendment flow).
2. Update `Cargo.toml` `[workspace.dependencies]` — respect the coupled pins (see gotchas.md).
3. Run the gates (`bash .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh fast` — fmt, clippy, test, CI scripts, embolden).
4. Commit as `chore: bump {crate} to {version}`.
